citations.text:
Statistical Analysis

The primary objective was to determine how the rate of TEAEs (ocular and nonocular) reported with besifloxacin ophthalmic suspension 0.6 % used three times daily for 7 days compared with the rate reported with vehicle alone. Exact 95 % confidence intervals were constructed around the proportion of subjects and eyes with each TEAE, and Fisher’s exact test was used to test for differences between treatment groups. A similar approach was used to summarize treatment-related AEs.
